title.zh: SmartLingo Guru 学习路径引导修正

purpose.zh: 修正 Guru 的双重图标、旧问题和 AI 将 Flash 误解为闪卡、推荐过时 Free 方案的回答。
purpose.en: Correct Guru's double icon, legacy suggestions, and AI replies that confuse Flash with flashcards or recommend an obsolete Free plan.

zh: Guru 常见问题按钮只显示居中的列表图标，保留无障碍名称；问题内容改为适合语言新人的 Flash／Max 引导。
AI 系统指引明确 Flash 是免登录的免费学习路径，Max 提供一次性七天试用与一对一角色导师，不再把 Flash 当成闪卡或推荐旧 Free 方案。
Flash、Max 和 Guru 新入口及支付、会员数据均保持上一成功发布版本。
en: Show only the centered list glyph on Guru's FAQ button while preserving accessibility; make suggested questions relevant to new Flash/Max learners.
Tell the AI that Flash is the public free path and Max has a one-time seven-day trial and one-to-one role tutor; stop confusing Flash with flashcards or recommending the retired Free plan.
Leave the Flash, Max and Guru entry flow, payment and membership data from the previous successful release unchanged.

zh: 仅 Guru 常见问题样式、引导问题、AI 指引和回归测试；不改变支付价格或数据库结构。
en: Only Guru FAQ styling, suggestions, AI instructions and regression tests; no price or database-schema changes.

zh: 旧问号在视觉上隐藏，列表图标居中；复用现有 Guru 服务端指引机制并改正产品事实，交互逻辑不变。
en: Hide the old visual question mark, center the list icon, and correct product facts in the existing Guru server instruction without changing interaction behavior.

zh: 构建、零警告 lint、TypeScript、全量测试及 Guru 产品事实回归检查通过；WebKit 与生产真实对话在部署时重新核验。
en: Build, zero-warning lint, TypeScript, full tests and Guru product-fact regressions passed; WebKit and a real production conversation are reverified during release.

zh: 普通会员的线上登录态验收仍需专用 QA 会话；本次不产生真实付款或开启直播。
en: Real signed-in ordinary-member production acceptance still requires a dedicated QA session; no real payment or live broadcast was initiated.

zh: 保留上一版本的十二种界面语言、Flash／Max 入口和既有教室权限。
en: Preserve the previous release's twelve interface languages, Flash/Max entries and existing room permissions.

rollback.zh: 无需数据回退；若需撤销图标修正，重新部署上一成功提交即可。
rollback.en: No data rollback is required; redeploy the previous successful commit to revert the icon correction.
